lines.words: 作词 : John Rzeznik/Robby Takac
作曲 : John Rzeznik/Robby Takac
And even though the moment passed me by
I still can't turn away
I saw the dreams you never thought you'd lose
tossed along the way
Letters that you never meant to send
Lost or thrown away
And now we're grown up orphans
That never knew their names
Don't belong to no one That's a shame
You could hide beside me
Maybe for a while
and I won't tell noone your name
I won't tell em' your name
Scars are souvenirs you never lose
The past is never far
Did you lose yourself somewhere out there
did you get to be a star
Don't it make you sad to know that life
is more that who we are
You grew up way too fast
and now there's nothing to believe
And reruns all become our history
A tired song keeps playing on
a tired radio
and I won't tell noone your name
I won't tell em' your name
I won't tell em' your name
I won't tell em' your name
Think about you all the time
But I don't need the same
If it's lonely where you are come back down,
and I won't tell em your name
